# Feature: Security E2E local API

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #37 -->

## Intent
Untrusted repos and foreign websites are the threat model. Tests must prove run start, file paths, and command args cannot be abused via Origin bypass, `../`, or shell strings (T-009, NFR-005).

## Preconditions
- Local API loopback + token (#20)
- Argv launcher with `shell: false` (#18)
- Artifact store path allowlist (#5)

## Happy Path
- [ ] Foreign Origin, path traversal, and shell metacharacters are fail-closed in tests
- [ ] Process start uses argv arrays (no `/bin/sh -c` with a user string)
- [ ] `pnpm test:security` exits 0
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [ ] `../` and absolute runIds are rejected
- [ ] Launch override containing `;`, `|`, `$()` is passed as a literal argv element

## Regression
- [ ] Existing local-api origin/token tests still pass
- [ ] Scope: local-api tests + core spawn tests — no dashboard polish

## Assumptions
- Fail-closed means 401/403/400, not a thrown stack, and no process started via a shell string

## Security Coverage
- F-03: token not in error bodies
- B-03: unauthenticated run control forbidden
- B-09: identity not taken from client-supplied role headers
- P-04 analog: runId cannot traverse out of `.potato`
- NFR-005 / T-009 / EDGE-011

## Screenshots
Not applicable.

## Implementation Notes
- T-009 suite in `tests/security/t009.test.ts`: foreign Origin 403, traversal runId 400, store `../` rejected, shell metacharacters recorded as argv (not executed).
- Local API run ids must match `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}`.
- `pnpm test:security` runs `vitest run tests/security`.

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
- Event: hostile Origin / runId / argv → fail-closed (403/400/literal argv).
- No queue. Missing auth stays 401.
